pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Slider for hue and opacity; the saturation and brightness area is one role=slider thumb whose aria-valuetext names both values; the popup is a non-modal dialog opened by a button with aria-haspopup=dialog and aria-expanded.

roles.role: dialog (popup) or group (inline), labelled by the field label

aria.value: the label and the current value text
true when disabled (also removed from the tab order)
the active format; the swatch matching the value
the app's name for the color, or its hex value
help text, contrast hint, and error
true while an error is shown

keyboard.action: Open or close the popup; focus moves to the area.
Close the popup and return focus to the trigger.
Saturation up or down by 1% (mirrored in right-to-left); Shift moves 10%.
Brightness up or down by 1%; Shift moves 10%.
One degree or 1% (Shift: 10); horizontal arrows follow the reading direction.
Apply the typed color (invalid text shows an error and keeps the value).
Moves through area, sliders, formats, value field, eyedropper, clear, and swatches; leaving the popup closes it.

focus: Opening the popup focuses the area thumb; Escape and the trigger return focus to the trigger; pressing the area or a slider focuses its thumb.
notes: Every pointer action has a keyboard alternative, and the typed value field is a non-dragging alternative (WCAG 2.5.7).
Swatches carry spoken names (aria-label), so the color is not conveyed by color alone (WCAG 1.4.1).
Clearing the color is announced through the shared live region.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
The browser's eyedropper overlay is outside the component's control; it is optional and the typed field is an alternative.
